touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Manton qualifies as a local detour through THE PRIORY and CHURCH OF ST MARY. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Manton: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
